name: Rand Wallet
notes: One palette for iOS, Android and the shared ui/. Dark (ink) is the default; light (paper) is a full theme. The identity is the entropy field: ordered-dither grain seeded from the wallet's address, always ink with bone grain in both themes, with a few pixels in the signal colour. Signal is the only accent: the primary action and the hot pixels. Nothing else is coloured for decoration.

field.notes: The hero field is the same in both themes: ink with bone grain; its hot pixels use the theme's accent.

type.family: Inter for all UI text; Departure Mono (pixel, 11 px grid) for the wordmark and the balance figure only
type.mono: JetBrains Mono for keys, hashes and addresses
